baseline.unrelated_edits: All initial paths snapshotted; only listed paths differ. Existing toolchain, dependency versions, sample implementation and user edits preserved.

public_contract.legacy: ImageProcessor.process(bytes,effect,width:Float=0,height:Float=0) unchanged; source-sized PNG, uniform-only overrides; no original-byte-success fallback. Both routes preserve caller source bytes. Legacy IMAGE_EXPORT describes this route. Android remains predecode ProcessingError; composites unsupported.
public_contract.new: Optional ImageExportProvider with processor.queryImageExportSupport and processor.exportImage extensions; standalone suspend exportImage creates/uses/closes its own factory. No mandatory methods added to ImageProcessor or ShaderFactory; no JVM signature removed.
public_contract.pixels: ImageExportOptions requires integer output pixels; independent nullable positive finite coordinate dimensions default to output pixels. Stretch bilinear before effect, output-rectangle clipping.
public_contract.formats: Single-frame PNG/JPEG input; reject non-TOP_LEFT EXIF, animated PNG control chunk and animated codec input. PNG output only, no JPEG quality/flattening/fit/orientation normalization. Source metadata not copied; encoded output tagged sRGB with alpha.
public_contract.color: Explicit RGBA8888 premultiplied sRGB decoded bitmap and two raster stages; tested linear-profile source conversion and alpha. No GPU acceleration claim for Skia raster.
public_contract.limits: Encoded source1byte..8MiB; decoded source and output each <=4194304pixels and <=4096 per edge. Long arithmetic, eager decode, header preflight before providers. Admission limits do not cap codec/filter/native scratch or total memory.
public_contract.worker: One active + one queued suspend export globally; excess fails immediately. Queue borrows bytes/effect, copies bytes only after worker admission. Providers run in nonsuspend worker block; borrowed inputs retained by caller until completion; factory create/use/close on same worker thread. Sync processor route caller-serialized outside admission gate.
public_contract.cancel: Queued cancellation starts no native work; active cancellation releases gate/resources and suppresses delivery after native call returns. No driver/codec preemption or hard-timeout guarantee. Wasm Default is synchronous browser-event-loop work, not real background threading.
public_contract.workbench: CONTENT Run remains legacy ImageProcessor + separate remembered UI renderFactory, IMAGE_EXPORT preflight disabled on Android. BACKGROUND Run native modifier unchanged. No silent enabling or UI-factory transfer. Future migration must retain transactional revision/last-good/errors and worker ownership.
public_contract.chains: No offline chain support inferred from SX05 on-screen chains; exact bounded-route query rejects composites before decoding.

Native SIGSEGV RenderThread stack includes GraphicBuffer::from, Surface::hook_cancelBuffer, egl_window_surface destructor, eglDestroySurface, HWUI setSurface.
